desc: The EZ-Aim™ Portable Range Target Stand features a steel framed stand and coroplast board, for applying standard paper targets, or our EZ-Aim™ paper shooting targets, providing you the tools needed to sharpen your skills. Lightweight, portable target stand can be used almost anywhere by simply pushing the frame into the ground and is designed to adapt for use with the EZ-Aim™ Custom Target System. This range target stand ensures you have what you need to challenge your abilities as well as your imagination. Get creative and stay on target with EZ-Aim™.
